task: Ralph-token benchmark toy task: implement three trivial, deterministic string helpers against the scratch fixture, each in its own file, each with a matching micro-test.
notes: Canned, self-contained 3-story PRD used ONLY by the ralph-token benchmark. Stable and deterministic on purpose: the stories are small enough that a single ralph iteration handles each, and the acceptance criteria are exact so a real ralph run converges the same way every time. Do NOT edit to add scope — variance control depends on this staying fixed.

stories.title: Add slugify helper
stories.description: Create benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/slugify.ts exporting `slugify(input: string): string` that lowercases the input, trims it, and replaces every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, stripping leading/trailing hyphens.
acceptanceCriteria: File benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/slugify.ts exists and exports a function `slugify`.
A test file benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/slugify.test.ts exists and passes.

stories.title: Add titleCase helper
stories.description: Create benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/title-case.ts exporting `titleCase(input: string): string` that uppercases the first letter of each whitespace-separated word and lowercases the rest.
acceptanceCriteria: File benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/title-case.ts exists and exports a function `titleCase`.
A test file benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/title-case.test.ts exists and passes.

stories.title: Add truncate helper
stories.description: Create benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/truncate.ts exporting `truncate(input: string, max: number): string` that returns the input unchanged when its length is <= max, otherwise returns the first (max - 1) characters followed by a single ellipsis character.
acceptanceCriteria: File benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/truncate.ts exists and exports a function `truncate`.
A test file benchmarks/ralph-token/fixtures/scratch/truncate.test.ts exists and passes.
